verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is an API-key-driven HTTP service and ships an official CLI for scraping, crawling, exports and cron-based schedules, all of which can be scripted for unattended automation. The evidence never documents CI usage specifically, such as non-interactive flags, env-var auth or CI recipes, and scheduling is a gated advanced feature. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless runbook documentation, documented non-interactive CLI auth (e.g. env var/token), independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use the official ScrapingBee command-line interface for scraping, crawling, exports, schedules, and dedicated APIs.
`scrapingbee schedule` | Cron-based scheduled jobs; gated advanced feature.
To scrape a web page, you only need two things: Your API key... The encoded web page URL you want to scrape
